About.title: BORN IN JEDDAH.
About.lead: ALBAZAR — البازار — the bazaar. One roof, many makers, the whole world passing through. Not a mall: a marketplace with a pulse.
About.body1: The bazaar is Jeddah. Al-Balad — the old town, the Gate to Makkah — was a Red Sea port where merchants and pilgrims from Arabia, India, Africa and the Ottoman world unloaded into the same narrow streets. Coral-stone houses, carved rawasheen balconies, calligraphy over every door. A melting pot before the phrase existed: local soul, global traffic, under one roof.
About.body2: ALBAZAR is that same gate, rebuilt for now — a curated streetwear bazaar where Saudi taste hosts the world's best brands: Carhartt WIP, HUF, Butter Goods, Pleasures, Baker and more. We don't make the clothes; we choose them. Being carried in ALBAZAR is a signal: this got picked. From بلد جدة to the world.

Coral-stone houses, carved rawasheen balconies, calligraphy over every door — a melting pot before the phrase existed. ALBAZAR is that gate, rebuilt for now.
Jeddah.footerBody: Not a mall — a marketplace with a pulse. We don't make the clothes; we choose them. Being carried in ALBAZAR is a signal: this got picked. From the coral streets of Al-Balad to the feeds of the world, the street is the runway and the bazaar never closes. Curated, never just stocked. Saudi taste, the world's brands. Discovery, not retail.
